result.description:
Home Care - Support Worker  
 
 Pay rate: up to $36.49 per hour (based on experience) 
 Flexible work options: Part-time (contracts depends on your availability) 
 Increase your take-home pay with salary packaging benefits 
 
 At  RSL LifeCare , we have a dedicated and energetic Home Care team that's growing! Our team provides care services and support across the ACT & NSW to veterans and seniors in their own home. We have a highly rewarding opportunity for you to join a large social purpose organisation in the fastest-growing segment of the aged care industry as more and more Australians seek support to maintain their independence at home. Our vision of creating proud communities living their best lives is at the heart of everything we do as we continue to build upon our legacy of supporting veterans and their families for more than 100 years.   About the Role    As a Support Worker, you'll help people stay safe and comfortable at home by: 
 
 Helping with personal care (showering, dressing, grooming) 
 Providing respite care (giving carers a break) 
 Helping clients stay active and connected in their community 
 Following care plans to meet each person's needs 
 Working as a team to provide the best support possible 
 
  Why Work with Us?    We value and support our team. When you join us, you'll enjoy: 
 
 Salary packaging - Get up to $15,900 tax-free per year to increase your take-home pay 
 Retail discounts - Save money at 700+ stores 
 Fitness Passport 
 Extra pay on leave - 17.5% leave loading on annual leave 
 Career growth - Opportunities to move into Residential Care or Community Services 
 
  To succeed in this role we'd expect you to have:  
 
 A caring nature - genuinely passionate about helping people 
 Certificate in Individual Support, Aged Care or Disability 
 Good communication skills with the ability chat and listen to clients and team members 
 Ability to work independently & comfortable using technology 
 Australian working rights 
 A valid driver's licence and access to a reliable, insured car 
 A Police Check and/or NDIS Worker Screening Check (or willingness to get one) 
 Experience in aged care or disability support 
 First Aid and CPR certificate (or willingness to get one) 
 
  It is a mandatory requirement for a team member working in the Aged Care sector to have a valid Police Check or a valid National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS) check, or potentially both, to undertake the inherent requirements of the role. Clearances must be verified prior to commencing employment with RSL LifeCare.    Our commitment to diversity:    We are proud to stand for our unique values: Do the Right Thing, Aim Higher, Care from the Heart, and Act as One team.  We welcome and encourage applications from people across our diverse community, especially from Veterans, current serving ADF personnel, their families and Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander applicants. We believe everyone has the right to feel safe, respected, valued and heard regardless of their gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity or disability.  Please  click here  to apply.
